title: Microsoft compiler crashes building tts_windows.cpp
body: ### Tested versions Latest master (1f012286cf9321b2209259539d1e638dac4eed73). ### System information Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8115) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.95 GiB memory ### Issue description I can't seem to get master to build in the Visual Studio 2019.
